rules.statement: A person whose claim was dismissed for default of appearance must bring an action under section 247; he should not move to re-open the claim inquiry (by explaining the default) on the ground that the order was made ex parte.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the Legislature has enacted a particular remedy for a grievance in terms which show that it intended that remedy to be the only one open to an aggrieved party, redress cannot be sought by any other form of proceedings.
